messages:
devops-bot: INCIDENT alert: hosted-api-eu-west queue length > 10k for 3m, p95 latency 14.2s, p99 32.8s, GPU pool utilization 98% | Autoscaler: failed to provision additional hosts (quota error).

alice.sre: acked. paging oncall. starting triage.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. grabbing dashboards. queue spike looks correlated with a partner campaign hitting /v1/generate concurrently across many tenants.

ben.runtime: checked provisioner logs: `provisioner.create_node` returning 403 from cloud API: 
```
Error: QuotaExceeded: Cannot allocate GPUs (requested 24, available 0)
Region eu-west-2 quota=200, in-use=200
```
We can't auto-scale beyond quota.

carol.cs: CS has reports of customer errors: timeouts 504 and slow responses. Major SaaS-customer X is seeing 40% error rate for some routes. They're escalating.

alice.sre: impact summary: hosted API global fallback didn't fully kick (policy only routes to compatible variant if capacity available). p95/backlog loop is causing request retries to pile up. Immediate mitigation options: 1) enable fallback routing to dedicated reserved pool for critical tenants, 2) apply short-term per-key rate limits, 3) flip to smaller model variants for non-critical traffic, 4) increase timeouts/retry backoff for clients (preferred for graceful degradation).

oncall-sre: I'm going to try (1) and (3) in parallel. Starting with fallback route for `tenant=partner-campaign` to `dedicated-eu-fallback-pool` (risk: cost + auth checks).

ben.runtime: attempting manual node create to validate quota error. running: `cloudctl compute instances create --count 8 --gpu a100 --region eu-west-2`

ben.runtime: cloud API reply: `\{"error":"QuotaExceeded","message":"Requested GPUs would exceed quota for customer project"\}`

ops_pager: paging cloud infra contact for emergency quota bump. sending request now. ETA TBD.

alice.sre: while we wait, implement rate-limits on public routes and enable fallback for top 3 offending API keys. Going to push a short rule: `rate_limit: 100 rps per-key` for the campaign tag.

oncall-sre: rule applied via `kong` ingress. Confirming dropped requests count now.

oncall-sre: also flipped model routing for non-critical model `gpt-xl` -> `gpt-xl-quant` (lower GPU footprint). Doing a canary at 10% of traffic.

devops-bot: Change recorded: routing rule add by oncall-sre, model variant swap by oncall-sre.

alice.sre: monitoring — queue length down from 11.2k -> 6.1k in 4m after rate-limit + canary. p95 dropped from 14.2s -> 7.8s. p99 still high 25s.

carol.cs: notifying affected customers with interim message: "We're seeing degraded performance in EU region due to a traffic surge. We've applied mitigations and are routing traffic to fallback pools; some requests may be slower or receive reduced model fidelity. We're prioritizing the most impacted customers."

oncall-sre: cloud infra response: emergency quota request received, cloud support asking for business justification. They can open temporary soft-quota for 4 hours if we provide request id. Ops sent justification.

ben.runtime: check: some requests still time out at auth layer when we route to dedicated pool due to token mapping mismatch. Fixing mapping table and reconfiguring header passthrough now.

oncall-sre: header passthrough fix deployed. Verified 200 responses for samples routed to fallback.

alice.sre: next actions: 1) continue to monitor, 2) if quota bump granted, allow autoscaler to add nodes and shift more traffic off canary, 3) prepare postmortem and customer-impact spreadsheet.

ops_pager: cloud granted temporary quota +24 GPUs for 3 hours (ticket 78910). Autoscaler now allowed to provision.

ben.runtime: autoscaler started creating nodes. new GPUs onboarding: 16/24 available after imaging. queue now 1.1k, p95 1.9s, p99 6.2s.

oncall-sre: rolling back rate-limits to baseline (keeping small limits for partner keys until end of day). Reverting the 10% canary to full routing to quant variant for 30m then reassess.

alice.sre: handing off to evening oncall @eve.sre with summary: short summary + actions taken + outstanding: keep partner limits at 100rps, monitor p99 under 8s, confirm autoscaler healthy and quota reverts at end of 3h window. Copy of commands used in thread.

carol.cs: final note: drafted customer follow-up email with timeline and mitigations — will send once oncall verifies stabilization. :thumbsup:
